text:
As Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang Resigns, the Future of GeForce Hangs in the Balance
After 33 years, Jensen Huang has resigned from Nvidia, following a scandal involving a suspected Chinese spy. And while this has all kinds of implications for the economy as a whole, in our own little world of PC gaming, it's looking increasingly unlikely that GeForce is going to get much attention going forward, now that CFO Colette Kress has stepped up as interim CEO.

text:
AI Usage Up, PS6 and Xbox Helix Development Still Low in Newest GDC Dev Survey
GDC Festival of Gaming organizers released the data from their 15th annual game developer survey, the State of the Game Industry report. Over 2600 game developers anonymously responded, and the results show increased generative AI usage, not too many developers working on PlayStation 6 or Xbox Project Helix next-gen projects as of yet, an increase in the number of developers in a union, and more.
